newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian GIMV considers three groups to manage IPO.
newsitem.headline: Belgian GIMV considers three groups to manage IPO.

text.p: Belgian publicly-owned holding company GIMV said on Wednesday it was considering offers from three different consortia hoping to manage its planned initial public offering on the Brussels Stock Exchange.
In a statement, GIMV said it planned to list in the second half of June and and would make a final choice on lead manager nearer that time.
The three consortia whose offers are being considered are made up of the following financial institutions:
1. Banque Bruxelles Lambert, Dexia CC and CERA Bank
2. Generale Bank, Bank Paribas Belgium and Bacob
3. KB Securities, Bank Degroof and ASLK-CGER
